g.text: Align internal features first; keep missing tissue missing
All 12 sections have inspectable proposals. Cross = cavity anchor. Flips are geometric suggestions, not anatomical approvals.
Cropped edges do not move the anchor; remaining shape differences may reflect section level, tissue loss or imperfect landmarks.
